paragraphs.text: CISA added a SonicWall SonicOS MFA bypass flaw to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog while threat actors exploited an OpenSSH authentication bypass within hours of disclosure, and a chained Barracuda Email Security Gateway vulnerability enabled unauthenticated root access. These developments accelerate remediation timelines for perimeter and remote-access systems. Vulnerability and asset owners should prioritize inventory confirmation and patch deployment for affected firewall, SSH, and email gateway assets. Identity and access owners should validate that authentication bypass paths are closed and session controls remain effective.

A third-party cloud service breach exposed 7.7 million customer records at Iris Ohyama, while AI coding assistants leaked credentials into 1,122 public GitHub repositories and U.S. agencies warned of active targeting of industrial refrigeration controllers with potential physical consequences. These events expand supply-chain, developer tooling, and operational technology risk surfaces. Supplier risk owners should request assurance evidence from cloud providers and monitor third-party breach notifications. Data and privacy owners should audit AI tool configurations and secret scanning coverage. Detection and monitoring owners should verify OT controller segmentation and anomaly alerting.
